LF_NORMALIZED_SHA256.description: Text file content read with CRLF (\r\n) converted to LF (\n), encoded as UTF-8, then SHA-256 hashed. Platform-independent across Windows and Linux.

RAW_WORKTREE_BYTES.description: Exact byte-for-byte SHA-256 of the file on disk as checked out. On Windows with core.autocrlf=true, text files checked out with CRLF will have a different raw SHA than on Linux.

GIT_BLOB_SHA256.description: SHA-256 of the git blob object bytes (git cat-file -p <blob_sha>). For text files committed with LF, this matches LF_NORMALIZED_SHA256.

JSON_SORT_KEYS_PYTHON_SERIALIZATION.description: SHA-256 of json.dumps(schema_dict, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'). Used for programmatically derived schemas.

CANONICAL_JSON.description: RFC 8785 style canonical JSON (sorted keys, minimal separators (',', ':'), UTF-8).

HISTORICAL_HASH_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE.description: Erroneous/fabricated hash strings placed in the previous wave's generator script (generate_safe_repair_artifacts.py) that did not correspond to any repository file. Reconciled in this wave.
